name: Render
summary: Cloud hosting for web apps, services and databases.

flows.title: Roll back a service to a previous deploy
steps: In the Render Dashboard, go to the service's Deploys page.
Find a recent successful deploy and click Rollback.
On the confirmation page, click Rollback to this deploy. Render starts a new deploy from that deploy's build artifact.
A rollback from the dashboard turns off automatic deploys for the service. Once the underlying issue is resolved, turn them back on from the service's Settings page.

flows.title: Add an environment variable to a service
steps: In the Render Dashboard, select the service and click Environment in the left pane.
Under Environment Variables, click + Add Environment Variable, or click Add from .env to add variables in bulk.
Provide a Key and Value for each new environment variable.
Save the changes with one of the dropdown's three options: Save, rebuild, and deploy; Save and deploy; or Save only, which leaves the service on its old variables until its next deploy.
